what_the_seed_controls.flag: pk_train.py --seed s (seed 0 = frozen arms; new arms s = 1, 2); nothing else changes
what_the_seed_controls.lora_init: torch.manual_seed(s) immediately before get_peft_model: the LoRA A matrices (Kaiming-uniform) are drawn from it; B matrices are zero-initialised (seed-independent), so every seed starts from the base model's function
what_the_seed_controls.data_order: per epoch e: permutation default_rng(1000*s + 7 + e) of the examples, length-sorted inside chunks of 64 batches of 16, batch order inside each chunk permuted by the same generator (so the composition of each 16-question optimiser step changes with s)
what_the_seed_controls.dropout: LoRA dropout (p = 0.05) masks come from the torch CPU/CUDA generators seeded once at start (random.seed, np.random.seed, torch.manual_seed, torch.cuda.manual_seed_all with s)
what_the_seed_controls.not_controlled: GPU kernel non-determinism (bf16 matmul / sdpa reductions) and vLLM batch composition at inference; a seed-0 retrain is not bit-identical (measured on the GPU host in the clean-silver follow-up: 1,852 / 2,000 identical dev generations), so seed-to-seed spread includes this numerical noise plus the hardware change below
what_the_seed_controls.unchanged: data, targets, prompts, recipe, schedule, epochs, base weights, decoding, execution models, S_k fallbacks, selection rule

deviations_from_seed0_training_environme.device: seeds 1-2 train and decode on the second GPU host, 1x RTX 4090 24 GB (sm_89); seed 0 used the GPU host RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 97 GB (analysts' hardware split)
deviations_from_seed0_training_environme.micro_batch: micro-batch padded-token limit --train_tok 768 (seed 0: 8,192) without gradient checkpointing; the effective batch stays 16 questions per optimiser step and the per-step loss is the same token sum / n_answer_tokens accumulated over micro-batches, so the update is mathematically identical (only bf16 summation order and the dropout-mask draw sequence differ). Measured on the 4090 (seed 99, dry runs): train_tok 768 no checkpointing 1.130 s/step, peak allocated 22.10 GiB; gradient checkpointing at train_tok 8,192 1.676 s/step, 20.14 GiB; loss after 20 steps 0.4845 vs 0.4843 (same seed), i.e. the two micro-batchings give the same trajectory. The faster configuration is registered because the slower one would leave no GPU-hour cap for P_1 seeds.
deviations_from_seed0_training_environme.oom_fallback: if training stops with CUDA OOM: resume once from ckpt.pt (every 500 steps; same configuration); if it fails again, restart that seed from scratch with --grad_ckpt --train_tok 8192 (recorded); no other change
deviations_from_seed0_training_environme.images: training: tkgqa-gpu:latest on the second GPU host (torch 2.8.0+cu128, transformers 5.13.1 vs 5.12.1 for seed 0, peft 0.21.2 installed at run time as for seed 0); decoding: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.10.2 on the second GPU host (vLLM 0.10.2, transformers 4.56.1; seed 0: tkgqa-vllm:latest with vLLM 0.10.2); tokenisation verified identical (train prompt_ids_sha256_first100 9f1957ac... = seed 0; decode prompt_ids_sha256_first100 e236a6fc... = seed 0)
deviations_from_seed0_training_environme.gpu_memory_utilization: 0.90 (seed 0: 0.85; a KV-cache size knob, no decoding parameter)

freeze: Per arm a pre-test freeze (chosen checkpoint, tau, adapter sha256, train_stats sha256, dev raw/pred sha256, selection file sha256, execution models and code sha256) is written on the GPU host and saved as an artifact BEFORE its test decoding; after test execution every test prediction file (official {quid, ranked} format, 3 per arm) is hashed into multitq_kpct_seed_freeze_P.json, saved as an artifact BEFORE any scoring. Scoring is a separate CPU step that re-verifies the sha256 of each file first.

analyses_registered.A1_per_seed: test Hits@1 (and Hits@10) of P_5_lora0/1/2 (and P_1_lora0/1/2 if run): 3-S-seed per-question mean, 95% Poisson(1) bootstrap percentile CI (B = 2000, seed 0, multitq_eval.paired_poisson_bootstrap against a zero vector, as registered for single arms); the per-S-seed values are reported too
analyses_registered.A2_seed_summary: mean, sample SD (ddof = 1) and range of test Hits@1 over LoRA seeds 0, 1, 2; seed-mean arm P_k_loramean = per-question mean over the 9 (LoRA seed x S seed) runs, with its CI
analyses_registered.A3_P5_minus_S5: delta = P_5^seed - S_5 (3-S-seed mean), paired over 54,584 questions, B = 2000, seed 0; registered seed-0 value +0.02209 [+0.02078, +0.02338] (the k = 5 primary contrast reported descriptively in the registered results as KP3_descriptive k5) per seed and for the seed-mean arm
analyses_registered.A4_KP1_P5: P_5^seed vs AT2QA 0.887 (and ORACLE-T 0.869, TKG-Thinker 0.855, SCoP 0.825): ABOVE (CI lower > value) / BELOW (CI upper < value) / TIE, per seed and seed-mean; P_5 is the declared primary LLM arm at k = 5, so k_min_above (registered 5 for every comparator) is re-derived per seed descriptively (if P_5^seed is not ABOVE, k_min_above for that seed moves to the next k whose registered primary arm is ABOVE)
analyses_registered.A5_P5_vs_G5: descriptive per seed: P_5^seed - G_5 (frozen G_5 seed 0; the G_5 LoRA seeds are NOT_RUN in amendment G), paired bootstrap B = 2000
analyses_registered.A6_U5: descriptive per seed: P_5^seed - S_5 on U_5 (k05_s0 unseen-template stratum, frozen flags) and on its seen complement, B = 2000

A7_KPs_involving_P1.KP4: registered test: delta = P_1 - S_1 on U_1 (k01_s0 unseen-template stratum, n = 40,205); pass iff delta >= +0.030 AND Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p < 0.05 (B = 2000, seed 0, bootstrap over U_1); labels UNSEEN_TEMPLATE_GAIN / NO_UNSEEN_GAIN. Recomputed per LoRA seed (P_1^seed) and for the seed-mean arm; per seed, Holm step-down over {KP2, KP3, KP4(seed)} at family alpha 0.05 with KP2 and KP3 at their registered seed-0 values (they involve G_1 and GU_1 / S_1, not P_1; registered one-sided p = 0 for both)
A7_KPs_involving_P1.KP1_P1: P_1^seed vs the four comparators (ABOVE / BELOW / TIE), descriptive as registered for every arm
A7_KPs_involving_P1.KP3: does not involve P_1 at k = 1 (the declared primary LLM arm at k = 1 is G_1, declared on dev before test); unchanged and not recomputed. Descriptive companion: P_1^seed - S_1 on the full test
A7_KPs_involving_P1.primary_declaration: unchanged; reported descriptively whether P_1^seed's selected dev_sel2000 Hits@1 would have exceeded G_1's 0.799 (selection transparency only)
A7_KPs_involving_P1.descriptive: P_1^seed - S_1 on the seen complement (14,379)

analyses_registered.A8_seed_label: per contrast (A3, A5, A6, KP4): SEED_STABLE iff every LoRA seed's (0, 1, 2) 95% CI excludes 0 in the same direction as seed 0, else SEED_SENSITIVE; for the KP4 test and the KP1 labels also reported: whether the label (pass/fail after threshold + Holm, or ABOVE/BELOW/TIE) is identical across the three seeds (LABEL_STABLE / LABEL_SENSITIVE)
analyses_registered.A9_strata: test Hits@1 per qlabel (Single / Multiple) and answer_type (entity / time), per seed and seed-mean, Poisson bootstrap CI B = 1000 (descriptive)
analyses_registered.A10_dev: dev_sel2000 Hits@1 of every checkpoint x tau per seed and the selected configuration (selection transparency); cross-hardware control: the 4090 re-decode of the frozen seed-0 P_5 ep1 adapter executed on dev_sel2000 with the frozen execution (descriptive, quantifies the hardware component of seed spread)
